item1.reason: The patient explicitly says the sense of being watched was absent at the same shelter on Wednesday.

evidence.quote: on Wednesday I waited at the same place and didn’t feel watched.

item2.reason: The patient considers recognition and looking for the bus as alternatives and remains unsure.

evidence.quote: Afterward I wondered whether they recognized me, or were just looking for the bus. I still think about it occasionally, but I don’t really know what they were looking at.
